page.layout: Running head at top, centred: "PROMPTU. ICONUM". Page number top left: 194. Two round medallion portraits with legends, side by side, above the text. One column of text in the centre, two entries, one per paragraph. A decorative ornament below the text, with no printed words.

main_text.p: SIGISMVNDVS, Hungariæ & Bohemiæ Rex, Venceslai frater, mortuo Alberto communi omnium assensu Imperator creatur anno mundi 5372. à Christo nato 1410. Hic Imperatoriæ planè indolis, sapientia, eruditione, probitate ac liberalitate clarus, doctos fouit, ac dignitatibus ornauit. Attamen ab Amurathe Turcarum principe graui prælio victus, castris etiam exuitur. Hic per triennium magnam Europæ partem peragrauit, quò schisma Christiano nomini calamitosissimum extirparet: quare effecit ut reiectis adulterinis tribus Pontificibus qui Barionæ sedem inuaserat, Od[ink blot over the name][illegible, ~2 letters]olumnius omnium consensu Pontifex declararetur. obiit Sigismundus nulla relicta virili prole, cum annos 27. imperasset. Vide Egna.li.3.

ALBERTVS Dux Austriacus, post Sigismundi obitum Imperator designatur anno mundi 5399. à Christo nato 1437. Hic Sigismûdi gener cùm esset, post eius obitum hæres regnorum Bohemiæ & Hungariâ factus est. Morauos ac Sarmatas intra suos fines quiescere compulit. Bohemiæ factiones compescuit: Amurathe Turcam, qui Hungariâ inuaserat, fugauit: Synderouiam in deditionem accepit: inde in Græciam contendes, Thessalonicam expugnauit. Austriam repetens, moritur anno imperij sui (proh dura fata) secundo. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: The ink blot covers part of the word after "Od" in the first entry, so two letters are unreadable and the name is given as illegible. The legends on the two medallions are partly cut off at the edges of the coins. I have copied them as far as they can be read, and the split between the left and right legends is uncertain. The ornament below the text carries no printed words. The running head is printed as "PROMPTV. ICONVM" and has been normalised to u as a vowel.
